coverage_method: For each side's declared range action, rank hand classes by that action's frequency, expand classes by class-table multiplicity, keep exactly cap_per_side concrete combos (the boundary class may be partial), and divide kept combo weight by total action combo weight. Coverage is not conditioned on board removal.
